messages:
Leah (People Ops): dropping a quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Covering promos, comp exceptions, and a couple of benefits clarifications. Ask here and we'll update the FAQ.

Priya (IC3): quick one  are part-time ICs eligible for promotion this cycle? someone on my team went 0.6 FTE last year.

Marco (Comp): yes, part-time folks are eligible. Managers should normalize impact to FTE in the packet (e.g., prorated metrics) and explain scope. Calibration panel will evaluate on impact and scope, not just hours.

Ben (Eng Manager): hiring freeze question: if we promote internally but don't have open headcount, can teams get a comp exception?

Leah (People Ops): promotions can proceed even with constrained headcount; however comp exceptions that increase total comp above band require Exec approval and are reviewed case-by-case. We'll aim to provide a headcount/comp snapshot after calibration for planning.

Priya (IC3): remote location comp differences  will market adjustments consider location-based bands?

Marco (Comp): market adjustments are region-aware. For remote hires tied to a specific location, we use that locale's band. If someone relocates, comp is revisited per policy. Details in the comp doc.

Nora (HR): parental leave top-up question we saw in the chat: paid parental leave top-up for US roles remains unchanged; regional variants may differ. We'll post the benefits FAQ with examples (how top-up interacts with short-term disability) later today.

Priya (IC3): equity cliff/refresh timing  if you get promoted mid-cycle does that accelerate any equity refresh eligibility?

Marco (Comp): promotions do not automatically change cliff dates. Equity refreshes are separate and manager-nominated. If you feel someone should be prioritized for a refresh post-promo, use the refresh nomination form.

Ben (Eng Manager): appeals logistics: can an IC submit supporting docs after the manager conversation?

Leah (People Ops): yes  appeals open 14 days after the manager conversation. Parties can submit additional evidence via the appeal form; include manager notes and concrete examples. Committee aims to close within 10 business days.

payroll-bot: Payroll schedule note: Merit and market changes processed after approvals -> effective first full pay period after sign-off. More: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Payroll-Timelines-1774459999

Leah (People Ops): thanks everyone. I'll add these Qs to the Notion FAQ and post the manager checklist link here when ready. Office hours for managers Thu 11am PT, IC office hours Fri 3pm PT. :spiral_calendar:
